title: Introdusere nye personer og ting med det — introducing new participants
goal: Choose presentational det plus verb plus a discourse-new indefinite subject.

objectives.statement: Choose presentational det plus verb plus a discourse-new indefinite subject.

The contrast is not simply between correct and incorrect grammar. Both sentences are possible, but they organize the message differently. With a new participant:

en.value: There’s a package on the counter.

no.value: Det sitter en kunde i gangen.

en.value: There’s a customer sitting in the corridor.

no.value: Det kommer et bud snart.

en.value: A courier is coming soon.

no.value: Pakka ligger på disken.

en.value: The package is on the counter.

no.value: Kunden sitter i gangen.

en.value: The customer is sitting in the corridor.

no.value: Budet kommer snart.

en.value: The courier is coming soon.

. In the familiar-participant sentences, both speakers can already identify the package, customer, or courier.

sections.title: Transfer: moving into a new flat

spans.value: Now change the setting. Emil has just received the keys to a flat. His friend Nora enters first and reports what she discovers: an old table in the kitchen, a lamp in the bedroom, a cat on the balcony, and a neighbour approaching the door.
This situation has the same communicative need as Maja’s report. Nora sees people and things that Emil has not yet noticed, so she presents them as new information.
Possible models from similar situations are:

no.value: Det står et bord på kjøkkenet.

en.value: There’s a table standing in the kitchen.

no.value: Det ligger en nøkkel på gulvet.

en.value: There’s a key lying on the floor.

no.value: Det sitter en person på balkongen.

en.value: There’s a person sitting on the balcony.

no.value: Det kommer en nabo bort til døra.

en.value: A neighbour is coming over to the door.

prompt.value: Analyze the three presentational clauses shown in the options. Choose the complete analysis that correctly identifies the verb and the new indefinite noun phrase in every clause beginning with det, and states what Jonas learns for the first time.

options.text: Det står en varebil utenfor nå. — There’s a van standing outside now. Verb: står. New indefinite phrase: en varebil. Det kommer et bud opp trappa også. — There’s a courier coming up the stairs too. Verb: kommer. New indefinite phrase: et bud. Det ligger en ny pakke ved døra. — There’s a new package lying by the door. Verb: ligger. New indefinite phrase: en ny pakke. Jonas already knows all three participants, so none is new information.
options.why: The phrases are indefinite first mentions, so treating them as already known gives the wrong meaning.

options.text: Det står en varebil utenfor nå. — There’s a van standing outside now. Verb: står. New indefinite phrase: en varebil. Det kommer et bud opp trappa også. — There’s a courier coming up the stairs too. Verb: kommer. New indefinite phrase: et bud. Det ligger en ny pakke ved døra. — There’s a new package lying by the door. Verb: ligger. New indefinite phrase: en ny pakke. Jonas learns about all three participants for the first time.
options.why: This identifies all three verbs, all three indefinite noun phrases, and their new-information meaning.

options.text: Det står en varebil utenfor nå. — There’s a van standing outside now. Verb: en varebil. New indefinite phrase: står. Det kommer et bud opp trappa også. — There’s a courier coming up the stairs too. Verb: et bud. New indefinite phrase: kommer. Det ligger en ny pakke ved døra. — There’s a new package lying by the door. Verb: en ny pakke. New indefinite phrase: ligger.
options.why: The verb and the delayed indefinite noun phrase are assigned opposite roles.

explanation.value: Presentational det introduces a new participant before the logical subject; an already established participant normally remains the grammatical subject.

buckets.label: New indefinite participant: presentational det + verb + subject
Already-known participant: not a new indefinite introduction
